definitions.short: toil ; hence, a work , produce , property (as the result of labor)
definitions.full: H3018. yegia יְגִיעַ ] noun masculine toil, product ; — construct יְגִיעַ Gen 31:42 5 t.; suffix יְגִיעֲךָ Deut 28:33 ; יְגִיעֶ֑ךָ Job 39:11 ; יְגִיעֵךְ Ezek 23:29 ; יְגִיעוֺ Psa 109:11 ; Neh 5:13 ; יְגִיעָהּ Job 39:16 ; Jer 20:5 וִיגִיעֲכֶם Isa 55:2 ; וִיגִיעָם Psa 78:46 ; plural suffix יְגִיעַי Hosea 12:9 (but ᵐ5 יְגִיעָיו Che); — 1 toil , ׳יג כַּמַּיִם Gen 31:42 (E; || עֳנִי ), Job 39:11 ( = husbandry), laying of eggs 39:16 . 2 result of toil , product, produce, acquired property ; יְגִיעַי Hosea 12:9 (|| אוֺן , on text see above), Deut 28:33 (|| אדמתך מְּרִי ), Psa 78:46 (|| יְבוּל ); יְגִיעַכַּמַּיִם 128:2 , Hag 1:11 (|| בְּחֵמָה אָדָם, הָאֲדָמָה, תּוֺצִיא אֲשֶׁר יִצְהָר, תִּירוֺשׁ, דָּגָן, ); Neh 5:13 (|| בית ), Psa 109:11 (|| כלאֿשׁרלֿוֺ ), Isa 45:14 ( מצרים יגיע , || סַחַרכּֿוּשׁ ), 55:2 (|| כֶּסֶף ), Jer 3:24 (|| בָּנוֺת בָּנִים, בָּקָר, צאֹן ), 20:5 (|| יָקָר חֹסֶן, , of city), Ezek 23:29 ; of Job as product of God's hands ( ׳יְג כַּפֶיךָ ) Job 10:3 .

occurrences.englishText: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night.”
A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,
Also I shook out my lap, and said, “So may God shake out every man from his house, and from his labor, that doesn’t perform this promise; even may he be shaken out and emptied like this.”
Is it good to you that you should oppress,
Will you trust him, because his strength is great?
She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers.
He gave also their increase to the caterpillar,
Let the creditor seize all that he has.
For you will eat the labor of your hands.
Why do you spend money for that which is not bread,
But the shameful thing has devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all its gains, and all its precious things, yes, I will give all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hand of their enemies. They will make them captives, take them, and carry them to Babylon.

They will deal with you in hatred, and will take away all your labor, and will leave you naked and bare. The nakedness of your prostitution will be uncovered, both your lewdness and your prostitution.
“But I am Yahweh your God from the land of Egypt.
I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground produces, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”
